sheet.tipSub: No sheet was filled for the raid, and its category has no fixed sheet. Opens the raid event.

recommendations.tipSub: Nobody approved or discarded them yet – only approved points go to the raiders. Opens the report in the raid view.

logs.title: Assign logs
logs.tipSub: Several raids on the same evening fit by time; the automatic assignment picked none. Opens the raid's logs tab.

inbox.title: Addon inbox
inbox.tipSub: The addon uploaded loot that belongs to no raid yet. Opens the addon inbox under History & Loot.

channels.title: Delete archived channels

tip.one: {count} archived channel waiting to be deleted
tip.other: {count} archived channels waiting to be deleted

channels.tipSub: Archived channels are never deleted automatically. Opens the archive of the channels page, where an admin deletes them.

rolesync.title: Check roles

refOther.one: {count} member has @{role} only on the other server
refOther.other: {count} members have @{role} only on the other server

tip.one: {count} member carries a synced role without its source role
tip.other: {count} members carry a synced role without its source role

rolesync.tipSub: The role sync only adds and never removes. Whoever lost the role on one server keeps it on the other until someone removes it in Discord. Opens Settings → Discord servers.

channelMissing.title: Channel of {title} is missing
channelMissing.tip: The raid's Discord channel no longer exists
channelMissing.tipSub: The signup message went with it; the overviews show “channel missing” instead of a link. “Recreate channel” creates it by the naming rule in the event's category and posts the signup message there. Otherwise opens the raid event.

series.title: Series could not create the event: {reason}
series.tipSub: The series could not create the event of this date. It tries at most three times, 10 minutes apart, then only at the push of a button. Opens Raid events › Series with the reason and “Try again”.

tip.one: {count} commit is on main but not on the server
tip.other: {count} commits are on main but not on the server

deploy.tipSub: The automatic deployment did not pick up the latest version. Opens the guide: which secrets it needs and how to deploy by hand.

trial.title: Trial ends: {name}
trial.tipSub: Take over makes the person core, Extend moves the end 14 days on. Nothing changes by itself. Otherwise opens the roster.
